# Acme Web — AI assistant brief

## Mission
Web-based control panel that lets ops engineers schedule, monitor, and
roll back deployments of internal services. Used daily by ~50 engineers ;
downtime windows are unacceptable during business hours (EU + US).

## Stack
- Language / runtime : TypeScript / Node 22 (frontend) ; Java 24 / JVM 24 (backend).
- Frameworks (direct) : Angular 21 (zoneless, signals), Tailwind v4, Spring Boot 4.
- Build : `cd backend && mvn -B verify` ; `cd frontend && npm run build`.
- Tests : `cd backend && mvn -B test` ; `cd frontend && npm test -- --run`.

## How to build / test / run
- Build : `make build` (delegates to mvn + npm).
- Test : `make test` (full reactor + Vitest with coverage).
- Run dev : `make dev` (Spring Boot on :8080, ng serve on :4200).

## Conventions
- Branch : `feat/<area>-<slug>` ; never push to `main` directly.
- Commit subject : Conventional Commits (`feat`, `fix`, `refactor`, …).
- Backend : OpenAPI-first ; controllers implement generated interfaces under `backend/openapi/`.
- Frontend : signal stores in `frontend/src/app/features/<feature>/<feature>.store.ts` ; no raw HTTP in components.
- All UI text via Transloco — no hard-coded strings.
- DB migrations : Liquibase YAML under `backend/smith-database/src/main/resources/db/changelog/`.

## When to load which spec
- User asks WHAT → read `.smith/FUNCTIONAL_SPECIFICATION.MD`.
- User asks HOW (architecture / modules / persistence) → read `.smith/TECHNICAL_SPECIFICATION.MD`.
- User asks which library / version / CVE surface → read `.smith/technical_config.yaml`.

## Smith CLI in this repo
- Adapted skills live under `.claude/skills/`.
- Generation report : `.smith/GENERATION_REPORT.MD`.
- For Smith-CLI commands (`/smith-*`), run `/smith-help` in Claude Code.

## Tools to prefer
- Maven : run via the `/mvn` skill (Haiku-offload) — keeps the build log
  out of the parent context.
- npm : run via the `/npm` skill, same reason.
- Database inspection : the `/db` skill (read-only; mutations require
  explicit confirmation).

## Tools to avoid
- `mvn spring-boot:run` from this session — runs forever, blocks the
  turn. Use `make dev` in a separate terminal instead.
- `npm run start` / `ng serve` from this session — same reason.
- `git push --force` on `main` or release branches — protected. If
  needed on a feature branch, ask first.

## Glossary
- Deployment : a versioned bundle of one or more service images pushed
  to staging or prod.
- Window : a sanctioned slot during which deployments may happen
  (config'd per environment).
- Rollback : `acme rollback <deployment-id>` (CLI in `tooling/acme-cli/`).
